description: Find a ready-made maviapi API for a website or topic, e.g. "hotels", "flights", "booking.com" or "turkish news". maviapi turns websites that have no official API into structured JSON endpoints, and monitors and repairs them when the site changes. Leave `query` empty to list every API. Next step: get_api, to see an API's endpoints and parameters.

query.description: Website, domain, or topic to look for. Empty lists everything.

name: search_apis
title: Search maviapi APIs
